event_name: Time 16:08 2018 CANADIAN GRAND PRIX 7 - 10 June 2018 The Stewards have received a request from Haas F1 Team to allow car 8 to start the race despite not setting a time in qualifying. In accordance with Article 35.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, the Stewards grant permission for car 8, Romain Grosjean, to start the race as the driver has set satisfactory times in practice at this Event.
